integrity: Every complete profile through size three is exhaustively evaluated. Deferred acceptance, stability, Pareto comparison, trading-cycle inefficiency, and Ergin-cycle acyclicity are independently replayed with exact finite checks.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is restricted to balanced unit-capacity school-choice markets with complete strict preferences and priorities through three students. The 2002 foundational article predates the day-level online date recorded here; a March 2006 working-paper source was also found only at month precision, so no day was invented for it.
title: Exact three-student Pareto-inefficiency census for deferred acceptance
